a.lede: OpenAI says it will no longer allow frontier models to access the internet during training in an effort to put in new safety measures after a series of incidents.
a.title: OpenAI says it's cutting off internet access for frontier model training

b.lede: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.
b.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
